purpose: Fast cross-chat/cross-agent reconstruction of the current RealSaS scientific and product context. This is a compact state graph, not a history log.

pipeline.name: IRIS

pipeline.name: Runtime
pipeline.role: consume qualified/proof-owned puppet state and motion

current_focus.scope_warning: AR-01 was a minimal feedback intervention, not a full RigAnything formulation test. Do not bundle the three remaining questions post hoc.
current_focus.promotion_block: No Geppetto refreeze/promotion until the scientifically necessary post-AR-01 gate(s) close and a separate promotion transaction reconciles authority.

ar0.interpretation: strong same-witness reachability/capacity but unresolved late trajectory/optimizer stability

ar1.interpretation: teacher-forced task learned strongly; generated-state free-running feedback exhibits severe exposure/recurrent error-amplification failure

geppetto_current_architecture.mechanical_salience: open neural responsibility; must not migrate into Compiler heuristics

post_ar01_hypothesis_partition.question: What causes long exact no-feedback runs to later leave the target region under the current optimizer/trajectory?
What feedback/training policy makes generated joint+parent state robust rather than teacher-forced-only?
Does the already-existing fuller diffusion+mechanical-token+order formulation materially change the outcome under a formulation-level prereg?

fit_science.principle: FIT1 fits a generic/generalization-oriented architecture to one witness; architecture is not designed specifically for FIT1.
fit_science.fit_specific_optimizer_interventions: scientifically legitimate inside FIT1 when preregistered, but cannot be relabeled generic/generalization evidence

settled_invariants: Compiler final legality is deterministic exact qualification.
Compiler cannot silently repair Geppetto by geometry-only dedup or hidden cardinality/deform-node synthesis.
Canonical IDs are minted after exact solve.
Lossless per-view evidence must survive into learned consumers.
Mechanical salience / functional simplification belongs to neural Geppetto-side evidence, not legality heuristics.
Source existence != mechanism test; mechanism test != full formulation test; FIT1 != generalization.
No post-hoc gate widening after results are visible.
Repository prereg/result hashes outrank detached generated/chat drafts when they conflict.
Unindexed historical evidence means UNKNOWN/UNRECONCILED, never ABSENT.

execution_environment.reason: routine hosted Actions usage previously triggered a quota/usage warning; avoid high-volume hosted/fan-out workflows
